opening.argument: The promotion ties profit and bonuses directly to buying one of five paid packages, then describes earnings through a sales team and matching bonuses across two generations. It also promises that viewers will profit as token prices increase, while presenting OneCoin as a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. Taken together, these are concrete recruitment commissions and tiered team incentives attached to paid purchases, alongside claims of profit from token appreciation. The pitch is not limited to explaining cryptocurrency: it urges participation in a package-based sales structure and presents recruitment-linked bonuses as a way to earn. The evidence establishes that solicitation and commission structure; it does not establish that viewers actually suffered losses or received any particular outcome.
